elementValueMap.message: =IF(orderProductItem:status != 'CANCELED', '', IF((DRE_IPGetDetailsProductOrder:orderStatus != 'DeliveryAndActivated' && DRE_IPGetDetailsProductOrder:orderStatus != 'InPayment'), 'Order status is incorrect.
